EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for your interest in the psychology program at ASU!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for expressing interest in the psychology master's program at Arizona State University. The Master of Science in Psychology is an intensive research-oriented program offering students an opportunity to learn in state-of-the art laboratory, computing and classroom spaces. The program is ideal for students who plant to continue on to a doctoral program in psychology or to pursue a career involving psychological research methods, such as marketing research, education research analysis, public policy analysis, research project management or program evaluation. For more information about the program feel free to review the MSP Program Handbook. https://newcollege.asu.edu/sites/default/files/advising/documents/ms_program_handbook_2016_1.2.pdf
Be sure to review our application checklist at this address: https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B44BICxe1BtdSkJZR2xmM0libjg/view?usp=sharing for more information about the application process in an easy to follow format, and peruse our sample schedule here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=0B91ycyfLEFl7Sl9ldm9lZnVoeEk to explore the flexible curriculum available for both full-time and part-time students. Also, please take a moment to check out our new e-magazine on our site and see all the exciting work being done by our faculty and students.
It's important to find the right fit in graduate school. A great way to learn more about this degree is to register for one of our upcoming information sessions. You can review the dates on our site, then email me to RSVP for any date you plan to attend.
Kindest regards, Graduate Studies
New College of Interdisciplinary Arts and Sciences Arizona State University, West campus nc.gradstudies@asu.edu
